newsitem.title: CANADA: Stampeder takes over Morgan Hydrocarbons.
newsitem.headline: Stampeder takes over Morgan Hydrocarbons.

text.p: Stampeder Exploration Ltd said it had completed its acquisition of Morgan Hydrocarbons Inc pursuant to its take-over bid that expired Thursday.
Stampeder said it acquired about 71 million shares representing more than 93 percent of the total issued and outstanding shares of Morgan.
It said it would take steps immediately to acquire all remaining shares of Morgan not tendered to its bid through its statutory right of compulsory acquisition.
After acquiring the balance of the Morgan shares, Stampeder will have about 92.2 million common shares outstanding with a market capitalization of about C$521 million, it said.
Stampeder, an oil explorer, also said it had received approval to list its common shares for trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Trading is set to begin October 11 under the symbol "SDX," it said, adding that its common shares will continue to trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the same symbol.
